sections.body: DIGESTIVE system: breaks down food (mouth, stomach, intestines).
CIRCULATORY system: the heart pumps blood through blood vessels, carrying oxygen and food to every cell.
RESPIRATORY system: lungs take in oxygen and breathe out carbon dioxide.
SKELETAL system: 206 bones in an adult support you and protect organs (the skull protects the brain).

quiz.q: Which organ pumps blood around the body?
hints: It's part of the circulatory system.
Lungs are for breathing. The stomach is for digestion. Blood pumping is the job of the…?
quiz.explain: The heart pumps blood around the body.

quiz.q: What gas do your lungs take in that your body needs?
hints: Your cells need it; you breathe out the other one.
Plants take in carbon dioxide. Humans take in the opposite one.
quiz.explain: We breathe in oxygen and breathe out carbon dioxide.
